Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Reyda wrote:
> Playing fame on julius : is it a good idea ?

Julius goes to torpor before his card text burns him, if that's
what you're asking.

As to whether it's a good idea or not, I guess that that depends
on who controls him.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He's not even an exception.
If he's burned by aggravated damage, he doesn't go to torpor.

His card text won't burn him until he goes to torpor (card text).
